digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics analyzer toolchain and dev bootstrap
propositions: Makefile install and install-unlocked targets must explicitly name the metrics extra alongside dev to make analyzer dependencies visible and robust to future refactoring.
lizard is already transitively installed via the dev extra but lacks explicit intent documentation in the bootstrap paths.
scc (Go) and jscpd (Node) cannot be installed via Python extras and require documented manual installation steps using brew and npm.
Local dev env documentation must state that scc and jscpd are optional and that their absence degrades to Unavailable rather than failure.
Dev venv provisioned by edited Makefile targets must successfully import lizard 1.23.0 and run metrics without erroring when external analyzers are absent.
